title: Three Evenings and One Short Screen
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：interaction　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 interaction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1997 the teacher ① recorded the interaction that no pupil in the classroom would have described, and he said the recording was the whole of the Monday. The ② interaction, meaning the exchange itself and not the screen, ran three Mondays and stayed undescribed in the book; interaction, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of interaction in that classroom had the same short screen beside it, and the ④ interaction at the far row, meaning the question they kept for the children to answer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Interaction, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the interaction was the whole of the matter, meaning the contact and not the exchange. The ⑥ interaction, meaning the contact and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; interaction, he said, is either something you record or the only word that means both exchange and a contact. He said the contact is the part they remember.

By 2002 the ⑦ interaction had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short screen. The ⑧ interaction of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three Mondays of describing; interaction, he said, is either the question at the far row or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ interaction I remember is the interaction described in the log, which closed in 2004 and is still described as the quietest in the classroom. ⑩ Interaction, my mother said in 2006, is the only thing that improves by being described; all interaction, she said, is a contact that has agreed to look like exchange. She said the contact was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 互动；交流（指教室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 互动；交流（指那次交流本身，与屏幕相对）
C. 固定搭配：record the interaction 录下这次互动
D. n. 互动；交流（指留给孩子们回答的一个那一次）
E. n. 交往之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的互动之事）
F. n. 互动；交流（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一次）
G. n. 来往、联系（指一件事里人人都聊却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联系（抽象总称，指人人都聊却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: recorded the interaction that no pupil in the classroom would have described

answers.why: record the interaction 意为“录下这次互动”，1997 年那位老师把教室里没有一位小学生肯描述的一次互动做了一遍。
interaction 意为“互动；交流”，指那次交流本身而不是屏幕，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被描述。
interaction 意为“互动；交流”，指教室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一块小小的屏幕。
interaction 意为“互动；交流”，指最远那排排边留给孩子们回答的一个那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
interaction 意为“来往、联系”，指一件事里人人都聊却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份联系就是那件事的全部。
interaction 意为“联系”，指人人都聊却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次交流，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
interaction 意为“互动；交流”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一次，到 2002 年这一次成了记录里的一行。
interaction 意为“交往之事”，老师三月写道，整件事的互动之事是一处教室和三个星期一的描述。
interaction 意为“互动；交流”，我记得的是记录里描述过的那一次，2004 年存下了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一次。
interaction 为抽象总称，母亲 2006 年说，互动是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的交流。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1997 年那位老师录下了教室里没有一位小学生肯描述的一次互动，他说这一遍才是那个星期一的全部。（record the interaction）
那次互动，指的是那次交流本身而不是屏幕，经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被描述。（interaction）
那处教室里每一种互动旁边都有同一块小小的屏幕。（interaction）
